import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import io

# Load the dataset from the string
csv_data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# Set a professional and clean style for the plot
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="muted")

# Create the figure and axes
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 9))

# Create the bubble chart (a scatter plot with variable size and color)

# y-axis: megapixels
# bubble size: weight_grams
# bubble color: brand
# marker style: body_type

    data=df,
    x='price_usd',
    y='megapixels',
    hue='brand',
    size='weight_grams',
    style='body_type',
    sizes=(200, 2000),  # Control the min and max size of bubbles
    palette='viridis',
    alpha=0.8,
    edgecolor='black',
    linewidth=1.5,
    ax=ax
)

# Add annotations for each point to provide more context
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax.text(row['price_usd'] + 50, row['megapixels'],
            f"{row['model_year']}\n{row['sensor_type']}",
            fontdict={'size': 9, 'color': 'black', 'weight': 'semibold'},
            ha='left', va='center')

# Improve plot aesthetics and clarity
ax.set_title('Camera Market Analysis: Price, Performance, and Physical Specs', fontsize=18, weight='bold', pad=20)
ax.set_xlabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=14, labelpad=15)
ax.set_ylabel('Megapixels (MP)', fontsize=14, labelpad=15)

# Format x-axis ticks as currency
formatter = mticker.FormatStrFormatter('$%.0f')
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(formatter)

# Customize tick parameters
ax.tick_params(axis='both', which='major', labelsize=12)

# Adjust the legend to be outside the plot for better readability
ax.legend(title='Legend', bbox_to_anchor=(1.05, 1), loc='upper left', borderaxespad=0., fontsize=11, title_fontsize=13)

# Use a tight layout to ensure everything fits, adjusting for the external legend
